jetbrains-mono-var.woff2  JetBrains Mono, Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors

Both fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). They are bundled locally so the UI never
requests a web font: on an air-gapped workstation that request would itself
be an outbound connection.

Icons in index.html are from Lucide (https://lucide.dev), ISC License.
